results.title: David Fallon Friedlander, MD, MPH, Named Recipient of the 2026 Rising Stars in Urology Research Award
results.description: BALTIMORE, Oct. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The American Urological Association® (AUA) and the Urology Care Foundation, the official foundation of the AUA, today announced David Fallon Friedlander, MD, MPH, as the recipient of the 2026 Rising Stars in Urology Research Award. Dr. Friedlander is an assistant professor in the Department of Urology at The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, where he studies ways to improve the quality and delivery of care for patients with kidney stone disease.
